Australian Annette Kellerman, pro swimmer, vaudeville star, entrepreneur and film actress, posing in the swim suit that got her arrested for indecency. c. 1907

Annette Marie Sarah Kellermann (1887 – 1975) was an Australian professional swimmer, vaudeville star, film actress, writer, and business owner.

Kellermann was one of the first women to wear a one-piece bathing costume, instead of the then-accepted pantaloons, which became so popular that she started her own fashion line of one-piece bathing suits. Kellermann helped popularize the sport of synchronised swimming and was one of the first women to attempt to swim the English Channel. She appeared in several movies, usually with aquatic themes, and as the star of A Daughter of the Gods was the first major actress to appear nude in a Hollywood production. In 1907, at the height of her popularity, Kellermann was arrested on Revere Beach, Massachusetts, for indecency, while wearing one of her one piece fitted bathing suits.
